impact.text: an attacker from re-calling `init` and hijacking the wallet

precondition_sources.text: The BuilderWallet is deployed by the factory via CREATE2 and the factory calls init(builderAdmin) immediately after deployment.
The init() function is publicly callable.
The init() function is not restricted to the factory.
The init() function is not protected against re-initialization.

intent_sources.text: init() must enforce one-time initialization and not be re-callable.
